why: rc21: NPC names, zone spellings, game alerts, minimap icon

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc21 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: game alerts. The red messages in the middle of the screen (Out of range, Invalid target, Ability is not ready yet and about 30 more) are shown in Persian. Switch: General > game alerts. A message that is not in the list stays English and lands in the misses list.
Fix: 1197 NPC names read as natural Persian (noun first, then the adjective: brown bear with a white beard is now a brown bear, white-bearded). Same word, same Persian everywhere (raptor, totem, golem, warlock, Venture Co.). The corrected names also follow into the quest texts.
Fix: 44 zone names: one spelling for one place (Dire Maul, Plaguelands, Scarlet Monastery, Silverpine, Elwynn, Ironforge, Mulgore, Eastern Kingdoms and more), corrected vowels. The old spelling is replaced in the quest texts as well.
Fix: the minimap button icon is centred in its ring.
Includes rc7 to rc20.

Data from ForeverDB.net
